name: echo deal with it
description: Proposal, the meme format of sunglasses that come down from above and land on a face that then plays it cool, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x): it rests with the family's slit eyes and blinks, glances up, plain dark shades with a grey rim and a white glint in each lens come down from the top of the frame in five stiff steps while its eyes stay up on them, they land on the visor with a one row dip, then the chin lifts a row, a one sided smirk comes up, a sparkle swells on the shades' corner, a shine runs across the lenses and the antenna pings twice through a long cool hold, before the shades go back up in three quick steps and it blinks; judge whether the stiff stepping reads as the meme's descent rather than a glitch, whether the shades read as shades over the visor rather than a black band, and whether it is still this creature.
